latency_qualification.scope: Separate from functional validity; strict-below comparison matches the existing harness. Consecutive repeated windows are not independent tail samples.

trimmed_parity.scope: Recorded allclose(rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5) assertions; exact equality and maximum difference are descriptive, without retained-PCM recomputation.

controls.scope: Logical cancellation only; supervisor start is not a GPU submission timestamp. Recorded return instants are not separately reconstructible.

admission_timing_scope: Control-to-first-ready includes preparation and first inference; hop service excludes whole-source identity/statistics preparation. Loads rotate complete files without concatenating PCM.

audio.scope: Callback execution and PipeWire-reported driver-position clock timing; not measured end-to-end audio latency, per-stream xrun recovery or a complete graph xrun count.

UI.scope: GUI-thread notifications and sampled properties, not physical presentation.

AC_lid.scope: Sampled readiness only, no unsampled continuity claim.

scope: Saved completed/closed trial evidence only; baseline hashes and recorded exact parity are checked without PCM recomputation. Four repeated23.4s excerpts, not whole-track performance or stem playback. No new thermal pass gate; retained thermal snapshots are audited separately.
